Constant minimum delay of 2 days enforced in constructor and setDelay.
Constant maximum delay of 30 days enforced in constructor and setDelay.

onlyAdmin; sets pendingAdmin to a new address.

onlyTimeLock; updates delay within MIN_DELAY/MAX_DELAY bounds.

onlyAdmin; clears queuedTransactions[txHash] for a queued transaction.

edges.reason: constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, granting privileges to an untrusted caller.
constructor execution and admin initialisation depend on the untrusted caller address.
onlyAdmin modifier gates setPendingAdmin on msg.sender == admin.
acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin before transferring admin.
onlyAdmin modifier gates executeTransaction on msg.sender == admin.
onlyAdmin modifier gates queueTransaction on msg.sender == admin.
onlyAdmin modifier gates cancelTransaction on msg.sender == admin.
acceptAdmin writes cleared pendingAdmin and accepts the untrusted caller as new admin.
queueTransaction requires eta >= block.timestamp + delay, making queue validity timestamp dependent.
executeTransaction checks block.timestamp against eta and eta + GRACE_PERIOD.
eta is compared directly against the miner-influenceable block.timestamp.
executeTransaction performs an external low-level value call to an admin-chosen target.
the low-level call can re-enter TimeLock before the caller's transaction context fully settles.
reverted/recursive call path can invoke acceptAdmin and change admin during execution flow.
re-entrant self-call path can invoke setDelay while executeTransaction is in progress.
executeTransaction writes queuedTransactions[txHash] = false before the external call.
executeTransaction reads queuedTransactions[txHash] to validate the tx is queued.
queueTransaction marks queuedTransactions[txHash] = true.
queueTransaction reads queuedTransactions[txHash] to reject duplicates.
cancelTransaction sets queuedTransactions[txHash] = false.
cancelTransaction reads queuedTransactions[txHash] to confirm it was queued.
delay is added to block.timestamp when validating eta in queueTransaction.
setDelay writes the new delay value after bound checks.
constructor validates and stores the initial delay.
constructor compares _delay against MIN_DELAY constant.
constructor compares _delay against MAX_DELAY constant.
queueTransaction calls _getTxHash to compute the mapping key.
cancelTransaction calls _getTxHash to compute the mapping key.
executeTransaction calls _getTxHash to compute the mapping key.
getTxHash delegates to the private _getTxHash helper.
_pendingAdmin parameter is written into the pendingAdmin state variable.
_delay parameter seeds the delay state variable in the constructor.
_delay parameter updates the delay state variable in setDelay.
target parameter is used as the external call destination.
value parameter is forwarded as ETH in the low-level call, enabling value-driven reentrancy.
signature parameter determines whether callData is built with a selector.
data parameter is appended to form the final callData payload.
eta parameter bounds the timestamp checks controlling execution.
txHash local is produced by _getTxHash.
callData local is the payload passed to the low-level call.
success local guards execution with require(success).
returnData local is returned from executeTransaction.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only feeds the pendingAdmin assignment inside setPendingAdmin.
Delay parameter is consumed by constructor bound checks and state initialisation.
Call target parameter is only meaningful for the low-level call in executeTransaction.
Forwarded ETH amount parameter is only consumed by executeTransaction's external call.
Signature parameter is only used to assemble callData inside executeTransaction.
Data parameter is only used to assemble callData inside executeTransaction.
Eta parameter only participates in the timestamp checks of executeTransaction.
Local hash is directly produced by the _getTxHash helper and used as its mapping key.
Local calldata buffer is consumed solely by the unsafe low-level call.
Success flag is the direct return of the unsafe low-level call.
Return data local is propagated as the return value of executeTransaction.
